descriptions.preferred: Acer laevigatum ‘Hóng Lóng' Rare "Red Dragon” Chinese Evergreen Maple Zones 6-10 ‘ Hóng Lóng' is the most amazing evergreen maple selection. Hóng Lóng' was a wild collected by Mark Weathington of the JC Raulston Arboretum. Unlike the species, the new growth on ‘ Hóng Lóng' is a deep maroon-red to purple-red, later maturing to green. The bark is a deep purple red. ‘ Hóng Lóng' does not like full sun. Give protection from the hot afternoon sun for this tree to thrive. ‘ Hóng Lóng

descriptions_zh.preferred: Acer laevigatum ‘Hóng Lóng' 稀有“Red Dragon”中国常绿枫，适生区 6-10。 ‘Hóng Lóng' 是极为出色的常绿枫选株。 ‘Hóng Lóng' 由 JC Raulston Arboretum 的 Mark Weathington 自野外采集获得。 与原种不同，‘Hóng Lóng' 的新梢呈深栗红至紫红色，后期成熟转绿。 树皮为深紫红色。 ‘Hóng Lóng' 不适合全日照，需避开炎热的午后强光，植株才能良好生长。 ‘Hóng Lóng' 在 10 年内可达 8-10 英尺高。 ‘Hóng Lóng' 的含义为“Red Dragon”。
